title: Affine-basis comparison for the presheaf coproduct of external coefficients
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X,Y schemes [def-pc-scheme], and f:X → Spec(k), g:Y → Spec(k) morphisms. Assume X is quasi-compact and f has affine diagonal. Let F and G be quasi-coherent modules on X and Y [pqf-def-coherent]. Given a type I in the schemes universe and a k-basis b indexed by I of Gamma(X,F), with the scalar module structure scalarObj f F at the top open [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], put P = coproduct_{i in I} G.val in presheaves of O_Y-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and D = pr2_*(pr1^*F tensor pr2^*G) [pqf-def-cohomology]. There is an isomorphism of presheaves of modules on the full subcategory of affine opens of Y between the restriction of P and the restriction of D.val. This asserts no sheafification or sheaf coproduct universal property.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine-open degree-zero calculation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: Apply the algebraic basis expansion to M=Gamma(X,F), then restrict its presheaf isomorphism to the affine-open subcategory using pushforward-zero.mapIso.

Apply the basis-independent external tensor comparison on the affine subcategory and compose the two isomorphisms. The common middle object is the concretely constructed constant-section tensor presheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_external_coproduct_comparison
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (I : Type w) (_b : Module.Basis I k (scalarObj f F (op ⊤))) :
    Nonempty ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀
        (ObjectProperty.ι (fun V : Y.Opens ↦ IsAffineOpen V))
        Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).obj (∐ fun _ : I ↦ G.val) ≅
      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀
        (ObjectProperty.ι (fun V : Y.Opens ↦ IsAffineOpen V))
        Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).val)
